description: Checks up to 5 references against public registries: DOI through Crossref, arXiv ids through the arXiv API, ISBN-10/13 through Open Library (checksum first). Returns title, year, venue and a BibTeX entry plus an APA-style string for each verified one; unknown ones come back as not_found. Authors are given for DOI and arXiv only. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

references.description: 1 to 5 DOIs, arXiv ids (arXiv:1706.03762) or ISBNs
